<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template for a Friedel‑Crafts acylation. The target molecule is likely acetophenone (CC(=O)c1ccccc1). To locate the appropriate template we can search the template catalog using the functional groups that are broken (halide) and formed (ketones). This should return template IDs that we can then apply to the target molecule to get the possible precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)c1ccccc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
